Large orange text overlays the center. The background features a large TV screen and a minimalist interior design. (2) The man performs a series of scouting gestures, putting his hand to his forehead while looking left and right. The woman stands to the side watching him. Yellow captions appear at the bottom. Suddenly, the man opens his mouth in a wide, exaggerated scream while his body shakes. The woman begins to laugh heartily. (3) The woman mimics the man's previous scouting posture while the man stands behind her. In a post-production edit, the man's head is enlarged inside a white circle. The woman speaks and then quickly runs out of the frame towards the left. Laughter emojis appear on the screen. (4) The man stands looking at the woman as he slightly lifts the bottom of his grey t-shirt to reveal his stomach. The woman stands with her hands clasped in front of her face, laughing. Large black and white text overlays the man as he continues to look down at his torso. (5) The man stands with his arms crossed over his chest, looking stoic. The woman stands next to him and begins to unbutton and remove her heavy yellow puffer jacket, tossing it slightly. She looks at the camera with a playful expression while more variety-style text captions appear. (6) The man performs a dramatic jump and lands on his knees on the floor, clutching his chest with both hands as if in pain. The woman stands over him, watching and laughing as he looks up and speaks with an exaggerated expression. Red and white captions emphasize his words. (7) The woman stands in the center while a small circular inset displays the man's face watching her. They both eventually break character and burst into uncontrollable laughter, leaning into each other as the video concludes with high-energy editing and multiple laughter emojis floating on the screen.
